gloss: to beg; to implore; to plead earnestly

definitions.gloss: to beg; to implore; to plead earnestly
definitions.explanation: To ask someone for something repeatedly and persistently until they agree. Stronger than {頼|たの}む, implying that the requester is desperate or very persistent. The {込|こ}む suffix adds the nuance of doing something thoroughly or intensely.

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}も{頼|たの}み{込|こ}んで{許可|きょか}をもらった。
examples.english: I begged repeatedly and got permission.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}に{頼|たの}み{込|こ}んで、{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}しを{手伝|てつだ}ってもらった。
examples.english: I begged my friend and got them to help me move.

examples.japanese: {締|し}め{切|き}りを{延|の}ばしてもらえるよう、{編集者|へんしゅうしゃ}に{必死|ひっし}で{頼|たの}み{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I desperately implored the editor to extend the deadline.

notes:
USAGE:
{頼|たの}み{込|こ}む is an intensified form of {頼|たの}む. The {込|こ}む suffix adds the meaning of doing something thoroughly, deeply, or persistently. The implication is that the request is not easily granted and requires repeated or heartfelt pleading.

CONJUGATION:
Godan verb (む → ま/み/む/め/も): {頼|たの}み{込|こ}まない, {頼|たの}み{込|こ}みます, {頼|たの}み{込|こ}む, {頼|たの}み{込|こ}めば, {頼|たの}み{込|こ}もう

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {必死|ひっし}に{頼|たの}み{込|こ}む (to beg desperately)
- {何度|なんど}も{頼|たの}み{込|こ}む (to beg again and again)
- {頭|あたま}を{下|さ}げて{頼|たの}み{込|こ}む (to bow one's head and plead)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頼|たの}み{込|こ}む: to beg, to implore (persistent, intense requesting)
- {頼|たの}む: to ask, to request (neutral)
- {懇願|こんがん}する: to entreat, to beseech (very formal)
- せがむ: to pester, to nag (casual, often childish)
